name: Blocks
summary:
This experience has a colliding points system. Use it if you want or ignore it. When two blocks collide, a point is given. Challenge a friend to see who can get the longest domino effect or chain reaction.  It can be as challenging or as simple as you like. This is a very casual experience allowing the user to play and enjoy as they desire.

Controllers-

Clean up or reset map: Press Y or B on your Oculus controllers
Teleportation: Hold down on Left or Right joystick on on either of your Oculus controllers
